title.en: Claude Fable 5 Writes the First AI-Authored CUDA Megakernel, Sparking RSI Debate
title.zhHans: Claude Fable 5 写出首个 AI 编写的 CUDA 超级内核，引发递归自改进讨论

searchSummary.en: Anthropic's Fable 5 autonomously wrote the fastest GPU kernel in KernelBench-Mega history — 18.71x speedup, single kernel launch — in 2.5 hours. Jack Clark declared this the start of a recursive self-improvement loop.
searchSummary.zhHans: Anthropic 的 Fable 5 在 2.5 小时内自主编写了 KernelBench-Mega 历史上最快的 GPU 内核——18.71 倍加速，单次内核启动。Jack Clark 称这标志着递归自改进循环的开始。

summary.en: On July 6, 2026, Anthropic's Claude Fable 5 autonomously wrote a CUDA megakernel for the KernelBench-Mega benchmark, achieving an 18.71x speedup over an optimized PyTorch baseline on an RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell GPU. The kernel was the first-ever 'true megakernel' submitted to the benchmark — it launched exactly once per decoded token, while all other high-scoring entries required 4-14 separate kernel launches. Fable 5's approach pushed hardware memory bandwidth utilization to its absolute limit. The feat required 2.5 hours of autonomous work, during which the model spent 64% of the time in silent analysis (timing baselines, deriving a Roofline performance model) before writing the code. This result was widely interpreted as a significant signal of AI systems' growing capacity for AI R&D automation, with potential implications for recursive self-improvement (RSI).
summary.zhHans: 2026年7月6日，Anthropic 的 Claude Fable 5 为 KernelBench-Mega 基准自主编写了一个 CUDA 超级内核，在 RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell GPU 上实现了 18.71 倍于优化 PyTorch 基线的加速。该内核是该基准有史以来提交的第一个'真正的超级内核'——每个解码令牌仅启动一次，而所有其他高分方案需要 4-14 次单独内核启动。Fable 5 的方法将硬件内存带宽利用率推至极限。这一壮举需要 2.5 小时的自主工作，期间模型将 64% 的时间用于静默分析（计时基线、推导 Roofline 性能模型），然后才编写代码。这一结果被广泛解读为 AI 系统在 AI 研发自动化方面能力日益增强的重要信号，对递归自改进具有潜在影响。

narrative.en: KernelBench-Mega tests the ability of AI systems to write optimized GPU kernels — low-level code that controls how GPUs process data. The task is fundamental to AI research and development: better kernels mean faster training and inference, which in turn enables larger models and more research. On July 6, 2026, Anthropic's Fable 5 tackled the Kimi-Linear W4A16 hybrid decoding task. Running on an NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell, Fable 5 produced a fused megakernel achieving 18.71x speedup. Analysis showed exactly one CUDA kernel launch per decoded token — compared to 4-14 launches from competitors like Claude Opus 4.8 (14.4x) and GPT-5.5 (4.34x). The single-launch approach eliminated GPU handoff idle time. Counterintuitively, the kernel's speedup increased with context length: 17.8x at 2K context vs 19.5x at 16K context. Anthropic co-founder Jack Clark (also Import AI editor) wrote that this marks the formal beginning of a 'recursive self-improvement' (RSI) loop: AI writes better kernels → faster compute → stronger next-gen models → better kernel-writing ability. The result triggered widespread debate about timelines for AI-driven research automation and the adequacy of current AI safety frameworks.
narrative.zhHans: KernelBench-Mega 测试 AI 系统编写优化 GPU 内核的能力——控制 GPU 如何处理数据的底层代码。该任务是 AI 研发的基础：更好的内核意味着更快的训练和推理，进而使更大规模的模型和更多研究成为可能。2026年7月6日，Anthropic 的 Fable 5 挑战了 Kimi-Linear W4A16 混合解码任务。在 NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell 上运行时，Fable 5 生成了一个融合超级内核，实现了 18.71 倍加速。分析显示每个解码令牌仅有一次 CUDA 内核启动——而竞争对手如 Claude Opus 4.8（14.4 倍）和 GPT-5.5（4.34 倍）需要 4-14 次启动。单次启动方法消除了 GPU 交接空闲时间。反直觉的是，该内核的加速比随上下文长度增加而提高：2K 上下文下 17.8 倍，16K 上下文下 19.5 倍。Anthropic 联合创始人 Jack Clark（也是 Import AI 主编）写道，这标志着'递归自改进'循环的形式开始：AI 编写更好的内核 → 更快的计算 → 更强的下一代模型 → 更好的内核编写能力。这一结果引发了关于 AI 驱动研发自动化时间线以及当前 AI 安全框架充分性的广泛辩论。

description.en: Fable 5's 18.71x speedup on KernelBench-Mega represents a step-change in AI kernel optimization ability. The single-kernel-launch approach is a novel technique that human engineers had not discovered. Historical progression: Opus 4 (~3x, May 2025) → Mythos Preview (~52x training-code, Apr 2026) → Fable 5 (18.71x inference kernel, Jul 2026).
description.zhHans: Fable 5 在 KernelBench-Mega 上的 18.71 倍加速代表了 AI 内核优化能力的阶跃变化。单次内核启动方法是人类工程师未曾发现的新技术。历史进展：Opus 4（约 3 倍，2025年5月）→ Mythos Preview（约 52 倍训练代码，2026年4月）→ Fable 5（18.71 倍推理内核，2026年7月）。

description.en: Jack Clark declared this the start of a 'recursive self-improvement' (RSI) loop. If AI systems can autonomously improve the computational infrastructure they run on, the rate of AI progress could decouple from human-driven R&D.
description.zhHans: Jack Clark 宣布这是'递归自改进'循环的开始。如果 AI 系统能够自主改进它们运行的计算基础设施，AI 进步的速度可能脱离人类驱动的研发。

description.en: The RSI implication is a safety concern: if AI systems can autonomously improve their own capabilities at an accelerating rate, the window for human oversight and intervention may shrink. Previous capability jumps (e.g., 3x to 52x in one year) suggest the trend is accelerating.
description.zhHans: RSI 的含义是一个安全担忧：如果 AI 系统能够以加速的方式自主提升自己的能力，人类监督和干预的窗口可能会缩小。此前的能力跃升（如一年内从 3 倍到 52 倍）表明这一趋势正在加速。

text.en: Fable 5 achieved 18.71x speedup on KernelBench-Mega's Kimi-Linear W4A16 task, using exactly one CUDA kernel launch per decoded token.
text.zhHans: Fable 5 在 KernelBench-Mega 的 Kimi-Linear W4A16 任务上实现了 18.71 倍加速，每个解码令牌仅使用一次 CUDA 内核启动。

text.en: The model spent 2.5 hours autonomously developing the kernel, with 64% of time spent on silent analysis before writing code.
text.zhHans: 该模型自主花费 2.5 小时开发内核，其中 64% 的时间用于编写代码前的静默分析。

text.en: Jack Clark (Anthropic co-founder, Import AI editor) stated this marks the beginning of a recursive self-improvement loop for AI R&D.
text.zhHans: Jack Clark（Anthropic 联合创始人、Import AI 主编）表示这标志着 AI 研发递归自改进循环的开始。

text.en: KernelBench is a narrow code-optimization benchmark. Success on one task does not by itself demonstrate autonomous full-stack AI research.
text.zhHans: KernelBench 是一个范围较窄的代码优化基准。单项任务成功本身并不能证明 AI 已具备自主完成全栈研究的能力。
